metadata.case_name: YU MAN CHUI v. CHOW CHI FUN

plaintiff.occupation_before: Operations worker employed by Dairy Farm Ltd. at the Airport
plaintiff.occupation_after: Security guard (acting supervisor) at General Security (HK) Ltd

injuries.description: torn lateral collateral ligament of the right knee
source: After the accident the plaintiff was admitted to Queen Elizabeth Hospital where he was found to have suffered a torn lateral collateral ligament of the right knee. The ligament was repaired at operation and he wore a plaster cost for three months, and was discharged from hospital on the 24th February, but returned to Queen Elizabeth Hospital because of pain in his leg and was hospitalised for two weeks before being finally discharged. The plaster cast was later removed and the plaintiff commenced physiotherapy.
injuries.icd_description: Rupture of lateral collateral ligament of knee

injuries.description: both ligaments at the knee are defective resulting in the plaintiff's knee being unstable; osteo-authritis of the knee is inevitable
source: Dr. Wedderburn advises that both ligaments at the knee are defective resulting in the plaintiff's knee being unstable and repair difficult; and it is a permanent condition. Dr Wedderburn is further of the opinion that osteo-authritis of the knee in this case is inevitable.
injuries.icd_description: Injury to multiple structures of knee

manifestations.description: The plaintiff states that he can now only stand for about an hour and then has to rest for 10 to 15 minutes
he has a bit of a limp which becomes more marked when he is tired
he suffers occasional pain, more particularly after he has been walking for some time
his injury has affected his ability to lift weights and is now quite unable to lift heavy objects
since the accident his injured knee gives way sometimes - at least two or three times a month

treatments_received: operation to repair the torn lateral collateral ligament
treatments_future: possible knee joint operation in about twenty years' time

losses.description: Reduced function of the right knee with instability; inability to squat properly; reduced ability to lift heavy objects; knee gives way occasionally
Can only stand for about an hour before needing to rest 10-15 minutes; has a limp which becomes more marked when tired; occasional pain after walking
